hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts via a proprietary pricing curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the pool's internal swap logic. Direct liquidity provision and donations are blocked by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate.
